It builds sorted ±5-day pools for every day of year except 60 (covering all baseline dates plus the 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05 extensions), takes the Hazen percentile, and smooths with a cumulative-sum 31-day filter whose cumsum folds every day of year into the target-day thresholds.
